Session cache of remote byte ranges

Source: R/cache.R
a5px_set_cache.Rd

Remote reads keep the byte ranges they fetch (header chunks and compressed blocks) in one cache shared by every read in the R session, so a read split into bbox chunks, or repeated, fetches each block once rather than once per call. Ranges are kept per source URL and store_opts, and the least recently used are dropped past the budget. Local files bypass the cache.

Usage

a5px_set_cache(max_mb)

a5px_cache_info()

a5px_clear_cache()

Arguments

max_mb

Numeric scalar (>= 0): the budget in MiB. 0 disables the cache and frees what it holds.

Value

a5px_set_cache() returns the previous budget in MiB, invisibly. a5px_cache_info() returns a list: entries, size_mb, max_mb, and since the cache was last cleared the hits and misses, the remote requests made and the fetched_mb they returned. a5px_clear_cache() returns NULL, invisibly.

Details

The cache assumes remote files do not change during the session. Clear it after a source is rewritten in place, or after pointing a URL at another endpoint through environment variables.

The default budget is 512 MiB, held to an eighth of the memory limit of the process's cgroup (a container, a Batch task or a systemd scope), so a task limited to 2 GiB caches at most 256 MiB. The environment variable A5PX_CACHE_MB, read when the first remote read starts, overrides it.

Examples

a5px_set_cache(1024)
a5px_cache_info()
#> $entries
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $size_mb
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $max_mb
#> [1] 1024
#> 
#> $hits
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $misses
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $requests
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $fetched_mb
#> [1] 0
#> 
a5px_clear_cache()
